The `CONTRIBUTING.md` of `pebblemap` does not say whether a change like this one needs an issue, and no issue mentions it. Should the typo fix have an issue, and if so, which one? The answer decides the name:

- with an issue `PM-<n>`: `git checkout -b dkirov/docs/PM-<n>/fix-install-typo main`
- with none: `git checkout -b dkirov/docs/fix-install-typo main`
